rows.en: Sharl: "First, allow me to congratulate you on your return, Doctor."
Debish: "Yes. On this day, 109 years later,
we have been able to gather together once more.
Surely this is divine providence."
Lyle: "Though we're a few people short."
Sharl: "Lyle!"
Debish: "No, it is all right. ...Lyle.
I, too, regret what happened to Wenimas.
Her talent was irreplaceable.
But there are things we must accomplish for this world's sake.
To that end, we cannot afford to lose anyone else.
I need your cooperation."
Lyle: "I know that.
That's why I'm here."
Debish: "Good. That is reassuring to hear."
Bernst: "Excuse me. I apologize for being late."
Debish: "Bernst... You have aged a little."
Bernst: "What a greeting...
Well, it has given me time to think about a great many things."
Debish: "...Oh? I look forward to hearing about that."
Bernst: "Oh, no.
It is nothing worth troubling you with, Doctor."
Sharl: "That reminds me. I have a report to make.
About that child: they've now
infiltrated their ship. They can coordinate with us from within."
Debish: "I see. So even that thing proved useful.
But it is only a stopgap. Let us not
expect too much of it."
Debish: "...Well, never mind.
Sharl. What about that one?"
Sharl: "Yes. Readjustments are currently underway."
Debish: "I see. Bernst, that prized creation of yours
is the same as ever."
Bernst: "If I recall, you were the one who sent her out
while she still required adjustments."
Debish: "I did not want a human being.
I ordered you to make a tool.
Instead, you added unnecessary things such as emotions..."
Bernst: "Unnecessary, you say...
I shall be more careful in future."
Sharl: "...Doctor, regarding our next steps..."
Debish: "...Yes. We could begin the 'activation' immediately,
but we cannot afford another failure like last time.
Let us wait a little longer for the time to be ripe."
Bernst: "You mean Rayblade?"
Debish: "Yes. The synchronization between that boy Touya
and Rayblade is certainly remarkable.
But I can hardly call it sufficient."
Bernst: "And I doubt he will cooperate with us."
Lyle: "His wishes don't matter.
If he won't cooperate, we'll force him into a position
where we can use him. What's the problem?"
Debish: "Lyle is right.
If my Goderius takes the lead, there should be no problem.
But that will come a little later.
Until then, let us grant foolish humanity a little time
to surrender to its fleeting pleasures..."
Bernst: "But that does not change the fact
that we too are human."
Debish: "Indeed. But we are different
from those fools who can do nothing
but enjoy what they are given.
And from the curse of 'individuality,' we can free people
with the 'power' we possess."
Bernst: "...Because individuality exists,
people fear being inferior to others and come to hate
those who surpass them. Is that it?"
Debish: "As long as people retain their individuality,
that immutable truth will persist for all eternity."
Bernst: "You have not changed, Dr. Debish."
Debish: "Are you reassured?"
Bernst: "...Yes. Very much so."
Sharl: "...Bernst, this is no time for debate.
Even as we proceed with preparations for the activation,
we have no time to sit idly by.
Doctor. I propose that we go to them once more."
Debish: "Sharl...
Very well. Do as you wish.
Bernst, Lyle. Accompany her."
Lyle: "...Understood."
Bernst: "...If that is your command."
Debish: "Then, Sharl. I am counting on you."
Sharl: "Yes. If you will excuse us."
Debish: "Sharl is a perceptive daughter.
Indeed, there is no time. I must summon it quickly.
Before they awaken..."
Valga: "Huaaah... Aaaaaah...
Whew! What a good sleep... Now, what year is it...?
Ones, tens, hundreds... F-four thousand years?!
...Hmm... Perhaps I've overslept a little... Hm?"
Valga: "...This reaction... Vorlia...?
No, that's not it. I see. So that one has finally awakened..."
Valga: "Well, then. I'd better go and wake
those two sleepyheads..."
Valga: "Let's go!"
Yamato: "Oh, welcome back nyow!"
Ai: "How did it go?"
Ymir: "Everything went smoothly. ...Including His Highness's coronation.
His Highness... No, His Majesty demonstrated that Agarthia still stands strong,
and declared that he would end the war as soon as possible.
With an Agarthian victory..."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "How's everyone reacting?"
Ymir: "His Majesty was already very popular with the people,
so they welcome him. The council is presenting a united front
in support as well. But the problem is
his declaration of a 'Holy War.'
And he even intends to deploy
the Guardian Armored Mech Fermion..."
Touya: "Is that such a big deal?"
Ymir: "A 'Holy War' is a total war that requires
all twelve of Agarthia's provinces to send troops.
But at the same time, it means there is no turning back.
It is practically a declaration that the king
can no longer handle matters through his own discretion alone."
Yamato: "In other words, he's fighting with his back to the wall."
Ymir: "The 'Holy War' declaration did cause an uproar in the hall,
but when the mayor of the 'ancient city' of Karua Kalba,
Kalsion Renward, immediately voiced support,
The other mayors soon followed suit.
Especially the five cities that had made secret agreements with Zigrim.
They were desperate to use this chance to regain trust."
Arthur: "Even if that is the fastest way
to end the war, it is an uncharacteristic choice for him."
Xiujian: "So he has decided to stake everything on this...
Could acting this way now be his attempt,
before Cain makes his move,
to establish an unshakable foundation?
By demonstrating his ability, rather than his entitlement..."
Miyasco: "We're receiving a transmission on the regular channel.
It's... from Prince Lodis..."
Sisk: "Huh? Why isn't he using
his usual private line?"
Ymir: "Put it through, anyway."
Lodis: "I assume you have already heard the general situation,
but the Kingdom of Agarthia will now launch a full offensive.
Accordingly, I request your cooperation."
Touya: "What?! You mean... You want us to fight Zigrim?!"
Lodis: "Did it not sound that way?
Only as part of our nation can your fighting strength
fulfill its true potential.
I will give you three ris (two hours) to decide.
If you become part of our army, all is well.
If you do not, we will regard you as enemies from then on."
Fain: "Y-Your Highness... No, Your Majesty!
What do you mean?! We..."
Lodis: "I ask only for your answer: will you become our allies,
or our enemies? I have no intention
of debating anything further. I await a favorable reply..."
Clovis: "..."
Fain: "No... Why on earth...?"
Ai: "What was that?! So those are Lodis's true colors?!"
Derock: "In the end, gaining power
changes people."
Xiujian: "I do not want to believe it, but..."
Touya: "You've gotta be kidding..."
Celica: "...Everyone. Why won't you believe in my brother?
Do you think everything he's tried to do up to now
was a lie?!"
Ymir: "Celica..."
Celica: "Why did my brother tell us about his birth?
Why did he let the Captain and Ymir return without detaining them,
and behave as though he were telling us to leave?
<FC:1E:3E><FC:04:3C:19:0A><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:19:F2>Celica: "Why did he give us a full three ris?!
Do you think all of that was just coincidence?!"
Ai: "...You're right. It doesn't add up."
Celica: "I don't know what he truly intends, but the actions and ideals
of the brother who wished for world peace weren't lies."
Clovis: "Celica's right.
It's easy to doubt, but losing the ability to believe in someone
is too sad a thing for a person. I want to believe in Lodis."
Aurelie: "Well, well. You actually say something worthwhile now and then."
Clovis: "Heh. Falling for me?"
Aurelie: "...If you weren't so flippant."
Clovis: "Huh?!"
Aurelie: "Oh, no, nothing!
I was talking to myself! Yes, you misheard me!"
Arthur: "At any rate, although we do not know his true intentions,
should we not continue to concentrate
on countering Ze=Ode, as we have until now?
And carry on his ideals."
Touya: "Yeah. Sorry, Celica."
Celica: "No. I'm glad you understand...
I think my brother has begun his own battle.
So let's concentrate on ours."
Ymir: "Yes. For now, we should return to the Holy Land
and consider what to do next."
Ymir: "Oh... Gen, Rosalie..."
Clovis: "What's up? Have you made up your mind?"
Gen: "...Yeah. I'll pilot a Spirit Mech and fight.
It isn't about admiration or anything like that. I want to fight
to protect Sis and everyone in this world."
Touya: "Rosalie, are you all right with that?"
Rosalie: "Of course I'm not.
But... I'm proud to have a brother who takes everyone's welfare
seriously, instead of treating it like a game..."
Touya: "Looks like you've made up your mind."
Rosalie: "Touya, about earlier... Um... I'm sorry."
Touya: "It's fine. But are you really all right with this?"
Rosalie: "Deep down, I still don't like it.
But... I'm proud to have a brother who takes everyone's welfare
seriously, instead of treating it like a game..."
Gen: "Sis..."
Rosalie: "But promise me you won't do anything reckless.
Until you can properly stand on your own,
I'm your guardian, you know."
Gen: "Don't worry! You've seen my skills, right?
Leave it to me!"
Rosalie: "That's why I'm worried!
Honestly, you get carried away so easily!"
Gen: "I get it, I get it!"
Clovis: "Then it's settled."
Ymir: "Captain, do you approve?"
Captain Roa: "Yes!"
Touya: "Right. Starting today, Gen is a Spirit Mech pilot.
Good to have you with us!"
Gen: "Yeah!"
Celea: "Oh, it seems your brother has gone out."
Bio: "So it didn't work out after all..."
Celea: "But you look happy about it."
Bio: "Do I? I'm disappointed that such a profitable opportunity
has slipped through my fingers."
Celea: "Heh heh... You're kind."
Bio: "Oh, come now..."
Celea: "That girl would have regained her memories before long.
In the worst case, they would have returned while she was fighting them, like before,
and she would have left your brother.
Before that could happen, you made him face the truth,
and prepared him to let her go himself...
Though one wrong move could have made things disastrous."
Bio: "Heh heh heh... Well, all's well that ends well.
We're each other's only blood relatives.
I couldn't stand by and watch my brother suffer."
Celea: "Those hardly sound like the words
of Bio, the ruthless merchant of death."
Bio: "Come now. I don't wear a mask
all the time, you know."
Celea: "Oh? I thought the face you're showing now
was the mask."
Bio: "Heh heh heh... You're right.
Even I don't know which is my real face.
Perhaps there was never such a thing in the first place..."
Growster: "A Holy War...
What are you thinking, Lodis...?
The remnants are gathering in York as well.
The name Sword Radiance is not to be underestimated after all...
I cannot let this drag on any longer..."
Growster: "...Perhaps I should take the field myself..."
Adjutant: "Prepare His Excellency's Baresios!"
Zigrim Soldier: "Yes, sir!"
Miyasco: "We'll soon arrive at the Holy Land."
Sisk: "Huh?! Wh-what? The radar..."
Ymir: "Th-that's... Rayode!!"
Sisk: "A-another reading!"
Touya: "H-hey, you've gotta be kidding...
Three Ze=Ode mechs?!"

review_batches.context: Full 257-row member examined: Ze=Ode reunion and philosophical disagreement, Valga's awakening, Lodis's coronation/ultimatum, Gen's recruitment, Bio/Celea and Growster. This slice covers the reunion up to Lyle's response.
review_batches.decisions: Keep 109 years, Wenimas regret without invented death details, unnamed child/creation and no premature identities. Preserve Debish's tool/emotion contempt, Lyle's coercion, Bernst's objections and individuality argument as speakers' views. Complete activation and things to be summoned remain unspecified.

row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o000ff.l01: Regret about Wenimas does not explicitly describe her death here. Keep the event broad and do not add a killer or cause.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o002e0.l01: That child is unnamed and gender-neutral in the report. Do not expose the infiltrator's identity from a future profile revelation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o0033b.l00: Debish's dehumanizing that thing and stopgap treatment are deliberate. Do not soften into a valued colleague or infer an actual mechanical object.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o0038b.l01: That one remains unnamed. It is not automatically the same referent as the infiltrating child mentioned at 23, nor does the English declare it a different entity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00405.l00: She is explicit in Bernst's source; he blames Debish for sending her out before adjustment was complete. No specific technical defect or identity is added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00448.l00: Tool versus human being and unwanted emotions are Debish's stated demands. Preserve their force without presenting his judgment as narration.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o005e1.l00: Lyle proposes forcing Touya into a situation in which they can use him, disregarding his wishes. No accepted alliance or willingness is implied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o0062d.l01: Goderius leading is Debish's proposed means; no explicit mechanism or direct object of the leading is stated here. Do not force an unclear omitted referent into him or it.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o006d7.l03: Power and individuality are quoted ideological terms. Keep freedom from individuality as Debish's claim, not an objective desirable outcome.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00749.l00: Bernst paraphrases the individuality/inferiority/envy rationale as a question. Do not erase the interrogative or make him affirm it without reservation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00814.l00: Very much reassured can carry irony in context. Preserve the surface response without narrator-added sincerity or a disclosed conspiracy.

review_batches.context: Debish's private aside, Valga's awakening and Lodis's accession/mobilization ultimatum. Read all 257 rows, including Celica's explanation and the following decisions.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the summoning/awakening referents concealed, four thousand years and two sleepyheads, Vorlia misidentification followed by correction, Highness-to-Majesty change, all twelve provinces, five secret-agreement cities and three ris/two-hour deadline. Karua Kalba/Kalsion Renward are editorial spellings; mayor gender remains unknown. Ultimatum is not consensual recruitment or a completed decision to fight Zigrim.

row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00927.l00: Debish entrusts Sharl with the task, not requests that she trust him.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00976.l00: Daughter follows both this line and the established Sharl Debish profile relationship; do not conflate her with the separate unnamed child/creation references.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00976.l01: It to be summoned and they who might awaken are not identified in this aside. Keep both referents unresolved.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00a1b.l02: Four thousand years, with digit-counting and stutter, is the explicit awakening reaction. Do not reduce to four hundred or treat it as a current calendar year.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00aa0.l00: Valga first considers Vorlia, then rejects that interpretation. Do not state the detected reaction is confirmed Vorlia.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00ae7.l01: Exactly two sleeping companions; no names or genders are supplied in this row.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00bc8.l00: Ymir corrects Highness to Majesty after the coronation; retain the change rather than normalize all prior addresses retroactively.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00c7a.l00: Popularity and council backing are Ymir's report. Presenting full support need not establish every member's private sincerity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00d3b.l00: The source explicitly defines compulsory troop dispatch from all twelve provinces and the total-war/no-way-back implications. No real-world religious or constitutional rules are imported.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00de7.l01: Karua Kalba and Kalsion Renward remain editorial spellings. The mayor's gender is not established and no pronoun is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00de7.l04: Exactly five cities made secret agreements with Zigrim and seek to regain trust. Do not silently change the count to the earlier elector-city group total.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00edd.l00: Xiujian hypothesizes Lodis seeks a firm basis before Cain acts; the hypothesis is not proof of Lodis's actual plan.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00edd.p01.l03: Entitlement versus demonstrated ability preserves the succession-related contrast without inventing a specific constitutional rule or legitimizing bloodline claim.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o00f68.l01: Prince Lodis is Miyasco's still-uncorrected source address, while Fain explicitly corrects his own at 144.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o010a8.l03: Exactly three ris with the source's printed two-hour equivalent; do not recalculate a different conversion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o010a8.l05: Refusal means being treated as enemies. Preserve the coercive ultimatum; do not recast it as a polite invitation or immediate declaration they already refused.

review_batches.context: Celica's defense, Clovis/Aurelie exchange, alternate Gen recruitment responses and Bio/Celea's explanation. Entire member examined before drafting.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve all controls and the repeated Celica label/open quote at 163, the three-ris question, support without claiming knowledge of Lodis's hidden plan, Gen's choice and Rosalie's mixed feelings. Bio's kindness and the Baio/Melissa separation are interpreted by Celea then partly acknowledged; keep masks ambiguous and alternate Rosalie branches separate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o0134c.l00: Celica cites his disclosure about his birth without restating unprovided details. Do not insert a family-tree or legitimacy explanation here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o0134c.l03: All four source controls and the duplicated Celica speaker/open quotation are preserved in their original physical row. Source block quotation parity is intentionally odd.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01426.l00: Celica admits she does not know Lodis's true intention while defending his ideals. Do not pretend she explains a confirmed covert plan.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01557.l01: Aurelie's flustered talking-to-myself/misheard denial is preserved as an awkward self-correction, not cleaned into an unambiguous confession.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o017f8.l00: Gen deliberately chooses combat to protect others, distinct from simply admiring pilots. No age or competence guarantee is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01888.l00: First Rosalie response; the parallel at 198-202 is a separate alternative. She is proud but is not happy about the danger.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o019e2.l02: Rosalie explicitly calls herself Gen's guardian until independence. Do not turn sibling care into biological motherhood.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01b26.l00: Gen becomes a Spirit Mech pilot here; the Royal Knights captain ambition remains separate from this appointment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01c1d.l00: Your brother is Celea speaking to Bio about the older Baio, not her own literal brother. Keep the two men's distinct names/roles.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01cd6.l00: Celea's counterfactual explanation of Melissa recovering memories and leaving Baio is retained as her reasoning; no new completed battle is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01cd6.l03: You means Bio, him means Baio, her means Melissa. Bio caused Baio to recognize the situation and prepare to let her go; do not reverse the assistance or breakup direction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01d7e.l01: Bio says the brothers are each other's only blood relatives. Do not make Celea a sibling.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01dd1.l00: Merchant of death is the blunt arms-dealer epithet, not a new supernatural profession.

review_batches.context: Final seventeen rows: Bio's real-face uncertainty, Growster's mobilization and three Ze=Ode readings at the Holy Land. All 257 source rows read.
review_batches.decisions: Sword Radiance and Baresios follow the glossary; do not attach the title to an unmentioned individual in this speech. Retain uncertainty, army remnants, Rayode identification and exactly three enemy mechs. This is the member's real final slice, not a shortened intermediate batch.

row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01e5d.l02: Bio remains unsure which face is real, perhaps neither. Do not resolve the ambiguity into a narrator-certified true personality.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01edf.l03: Sword Radiance follows the existing title. Source does not name its bearer here; do not add Garyud or Marie to this line by guess.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o01f88.l00: Adjutant orders preparation of Growster's Baresios; do not change the addressee into Growster preparing someone else's mech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_012.o02121.l01: Exactly three Ze=Ode mechs, not three named human members or three additional contacts beyond the stated total.
